The balance sheet appears strong for an investment- or asset-heavy issuer: current liquidity is solid at 1.71x, equity covers a large portion of the capital structure, and leverage is moderate with liabilities at about 52% of assets. Profitability is also robust, with EBIT of $7.5B on $18.0B of revenue, supporting an upper-medium-grade profile, though the scale of liabilities keeps it below the very highest categories.

DECISION: A
